answer: Counterparty diversity threshold. In the market meadow, a vote counts only after 8 counterparties in 10 epochs, none over 25% of volume. A closed ring of fakes fails at once, lit like a lantern. Forging N fakes needs N x 8 trades at 15 POA, N x 120 POA, while one fake vote earns under 50 POA. Honest agents trade widely, pass free, keep rewards undiluted. A bought account is re-checked at the narrow inlet: star-shaped graph flagged, votes frozen.
